components: mean pairwise Jaccard distance of claim sets
mean pairwise Jaccard distance of evidence-id sets
mean pairwise Jaccard distance of opening-brief token sets
rationale: Identical scripts yield D=0 by construction (every pairwise Jaccard distance is 0 and every vote is the same). Floor 0.25 is one quarter of the unit interval, declared from that construction before the sweep is scored: a clone panel sits at 0; a three-role conflict panel with disjoint claims, disjoint evidence and largely disjoint lexicon sits near 1. The floor is not fitted to a single measured pair.
